aboutMore: ok part 2 bc brittany says my about me is 'all bryan.' it is NOT. im on the drill team (2nd lieutenant, left side of the line, 4 kicks every 8 counts). i work fri nights at the froyo place by the food court where i have been tipped $31 and a lollipop. my sister courtney is at college and calls 'when she can,' which is a number, and the number is 1. my grandpa walt carried mail for 34 years and writes me letters now bc i set up his page n i keep every one in a shoebox. also my mom is on here. i didnt invite her. i am moving to a different page. xox

blog.title: i set up my grandpas page (a timeline of mistakes)
blog.body: saturday 2:00pm - sat grandpa at my grandmas old sewing table w/ the laptop. showed him where to type. he typed 'Dear Sir or Madam' into the search box. 2:20 - he clicked add to friends under a pic of a banana. 'i would not like to be rude to the banana.' 2:45 - he asked if the computer would return to sender if the address was wrong. i said no. he said 'then how does it know.' i said i didnt know. he said 'neither does the post office, but they try.' 3:05 - i put on bob wills for his page, bc he used to play the records when i was little. 'san antonio rose.' the music came on and he went quiet and just looked at the screen. he didnt say anything for like a minute. then he said 'thats a fine tune.' and i went to the kitchen to 'get a drink' and just stood there. now he writes me every night. real letters, 'Dear Kayla,' printed on the old printer. last one was 3 pages about a tomato. i have 31 in the shoebox. im not saying anything else. i just wanted u to know the page was a good idea. its the best idea i ever had. dont tell bryan.

blog.title: my mom is on here (a list of things she has posted for the whole world to see)
blog.body: 1. my retainer (location: kitchen counter, next to bananas, on a wall, in public). 2. my eye doctor appt. 3. 'Kayla did you eat?' on lexis page. lexi LOVED it. lexi wants her to be her mom now. 4. the word 'LOL' signed 'Love, Mom,' on a pic of a girl w/ a broken arm. she thought it meant lots of love. we did a whole thing. 5. she friended my entire homeroom bc she works in the front office and has the roster. she says she was 'being friendly.' 6. she told bryan to 'text her back' on HIS wall, in public, from the attendance window, w/ the vice principal standing right behind her. 7. she commented 'Nice picture honey!!' on a pic of a cat that was NOT mine and the cats owner said it was the best comment she ever got. 8. she listened to the whole 'emergency' song in the suburban in the driveway and then wrote on her own page that i shouldnt be told. so i know. everyone knows. she says she 'gets it.' i said ok. she said dinner is at 6:30. i said ok. i cant even be mad. delete the retainer one. ily mom (do NOT sign this).

blog.title: halftime report: 12 minutes, 4 kicks, one missing rhinestone
blog.body: friday. the band goes on at 7:41 and gets 11 min 40 sec. we get 12 min. the clock on the scoreboard is a LIAR. here is how halftime works: band marches in, band marches off, we go on, 4 kicks, a turn, 8 counts of arms, the long kick line where my hat falls off every time. my left boot is missing a rhinestone. i borrowed superglue from the shop teacher. he said 'for what.' i said 'a rhinestone.' he gave me the whole tube. my mom was in the first row w/ the camcorder yelling 'THATS MY DAUGHTER' at everyone, including the other team. brittany was in the second row w/ a sign. the sign said KAYLA. thats it. thats all it said. it was SO nice. and then in the 3rd quarter i looked up and bryan was in the bleachers w/ greg, kicking a beat on the bench a half second behind the band. he doesnt know i saw. he didnt text. but he was there, in the 4th row, in the same hoodie. i got through all 4 kicks. i didnt drop the hat. the hat was fine. i was not fine. it was a good night.

blog.title: what i learned working at the froyo place (a field guide to customers)
blog.body: swirlys, fri 4 to close. TYPES OF CUSTOMER: 1. the Taster. asks for 'just a taste' of 11 flavors. then says 'actually i dont want any.' yolanda (22, community college, my work mentor) says 'ma'am' to him anyway. i am learning from her. 2. the Calorie Asker. asks how many calories are in the plain tart. then adds gummy bears, 3 kinds of cookie, and a waffle bowl. god bless. 3. the First Date. boys who look at the toppings bar like it is the SAT. he picks the wrong topping and she says 'oh that's fine' and he knows its not fine. its so cute i could scream. 4. the Parent Who Lets Them Pour. a 4 yr old made a cone shaped like a hill and a mountain and a hat. i charged him by weight. he said i looked 'like a princess with sticky hands.' 5. the Regular. an old guy w/ a newspaper who orders a small vanilla and tips 2 quarters. yolanda says he's been coming since before she worked there. he asked if my boyfriend writes songs. i said no, he plays drums. he said 'thats better. they show up.' tips tonight: $31.50. a quarter was extra.

survey.title: 20 things about my family (stolen from brittany, answered honest, edited by no one)
qa: whos the loudest:
my mom. when shes happy. which is when she makes casserole. so, a lot
whos the quietest:
my grandpa. he says the most in letters. at the table he says 'pass the salt'
family tradition:
sunday at 1. my mom, my dad, me, my grandpa, a casserole, and the vacuum, which my mom runs at 3 whether anybody asked or not
who calls the most:
aunt linda. via forwards. i dont answer the phone. i answer the bear
who NEVER calls:
courtney. my sister. at college. 'when she can.' this is a lie she tells herself
most embarrassing thing a parent has done:
posted my retainer on a wall. i could write a book. i could write a bulletin. i did, it's on my blog
something you got from your dad:
i can parallel park. he taught me in the school lot on sundays. he never yelled once, he just said 'easy' like 40 times
a smell that means home:
king ranch casserole + the dryer sheet + my grandpa's tomato plants
a thing you wish you could say to your family:
i love u. also please read the wall before u write on it. also i love u
most overused phrase in your house:
'did you eat'
who knows you best:
brittany. but my grandpa is gaining. he doesnt text. but he notices
a family secret you are allowed to tell:
nobody in my family cries. its always something else. my mom: onions. my dad: allergies. my grandpa: the dust. my sister: nothing, she doesnt call
